# awattsdev

> Andrew Watts, bilingual (English/French) freelance developer based in Civray (Vienne 86), Nouvelle-Aquitaine, France. Websites, IT support, custom web applications and AI training for businesses and households around Civray, Sud Vienne and North Charente, and remotely across France, the UK and Europe.

## Services

- **Custom Web Applications & SaaS**: Web applications, ecommerce platforms and SaaS products built around how a business actually works. Admin dashboards, payments (PayPal, Stripe), multi-language storefronts, integrations with existing tools. Built with Next.js, React, Go and PostgreSQL. The client owns the code. Quoted per project. https://www.awattsdev.eu/fr/applications-web
- **AI Integration & Automation**: AI features and automation built into business tools: document processing, drafting, data extraction and workflow automation. Quoted per project.
- **Websites**: Custom-coded professional websites for small businesses from €650. Small sites are a one-off payment with free hosting on the client's own account; bigger sites (shop, bookings, client area) come with a monthly plan. Bilingual English/French. Delivered in 10 days from content receipt. https://www.awattsdev.eu/fr/creation-site-internet
- **AI Workshops**: 60-minute hands-on Claude AI workshop for small business owners. €50 per person. https://www.awattsdev.eu/fr/atelier-ia
- **IT Support**: Home visits around Civray or remote help, for households and businesses, in English or French. Hardware, software, email and network. €40/hour, no contracts. https://www.awattsdev.eu/fr/depannage-informatique

## Work

- SiliconSoup: custom online shop replacing WooCommerce, with admin dashboard, product options, PayPal checkout and verified reviews (Go + Vite).
- Gard'Apis: ecommerce store for a French beekeeping brand, 6 languages, hosted for around €13/month.
- einvoicer: SaaS for EU-compliant e-invoicing (Factur-X, Peppol BIS 3.0), integrated with the French Super PDP network. Videos: https://www.youtube.com/@einvoicer

## Location & Service Areas

Based in Civray (Vienne 86), Nouvelle-Aquitaine, France. Home visits around Civray (Charroux, Couhé, Gençay, Ruffec, Sauzé-Vaussais and nearby). Serving Sud Vienne, Poitiers, Angoulême, Vienne (86), Charente (16) and Nouvelle-Aquitaine in person, and clients across France, the UK and Europe remotely.
